title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
abstract: arXiv:2610.37588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models are widely proposed as core components for enabling agents to reason over long temporal and spatial horizons. Yet current evaluations often emphasize task performance while providing limited insight into whether learned world models acquire predictive latent dynamics that reflect the underlying structure of the environment. Here we introduce the concept of faithful latent world models as an equivariance condition between the environment's transition map and the learned latent dynamics. We propose latent rollout consistency (LRC) as a metric to evaluate action-conditioned latent prediction. Strikingly, we find that across the studied state of the art latent world models, none solves the task by actually faithfully modeling the dynamics of the environment.

translated_title: 理解潜在世界模型的局限性
translated_abstract: 世界模型被广泛提出作为使智能体能够在长时空范围内进行推理的核心组件。然而，当前的评估往往侧重于任务性能，而对于学习到的世界模型是否获得了能够反映环境底层结构的预测性潜在动态，所提供的洞察十分有限。在本文中，我们引入了“忠实潜在世界模型”的概念，将其定义为环境转移映射与学习到的潜在动态之间的等变性条件。我们提出了潜在展开一致性（Latent Rollout Consistency, LRC）作为评估动作条件潜在预测的指标。令人惊讶的是，我们发现所研究的所有最先进的潜在世界模型中，没有一个是通过真正忠实地建模环境动态来解决任务的。
tldr: 该论文提出“忠实潜在世界模型”概念及潜在展开一致性（LRC）评估指标，发现当前所有最先进的潜在世界模型在解决任务时都并未真正忠实地建模环境的动态。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of faithful latent world models and proposes latent rollout consistency (LRC) as an evaluation metric, revealing that none of the studied state-of-the-art latent world models actually solve tasks by faithfully modeling the environment's dynamics.
